info.name: HulaSalita API v1
info.description:
All /api/v1 endpoints of the HulaSalita Laravel API.

1. Start the API: php artisan serve
2. Run the '1. Public' folder first — the login requests save the tokens automatically.
3. Then run any other folder, or the whole collection with the Runner.

Tests check status codes, that answers are never sent early, and that private data is not exposed.
